a patient of well over 20 years I hope this practice might find some humility - though my recent experiences suggest that’s a vain hope! So I’ve no doubt this review will result in a a litany of excuses not least we are upgrading our systems and/or we are extremely busy. Let me be clear - this practice has deteriorated year on year exhibiting  a combination of ineptitude, rudeness, and all round apathy. There are the occasional beacons of civility and ability evident, but such positives are too oftened drowned by a surfeit of mediocrity at best.
Today’s latest episode prompts this overdue review. I have been diagnosed with AF and other related heart issues. Breathlessness has also been a serious issue though tests suggest there is no causal link. A recent chest x ray revealed no issues which means there must be other things going on which need a follow up by the Doctor. No such follow up was offered. This matters because if I was not able to check my results on the NHS app ( many will not have this ) I’d get no feedback at all. So I did as the practice states and tried to book on line . I completed the form only to get a reply saying they needed more information, so stating I need a follow up appointment doesn’t compute! So I added more info - another reply saying they needed more - asking what was it I wanted! I wanted an appointment.
I then get a text saying click this link to get an appointment. I click it and it says no appointments! Try later . I try later - no appointments! I try again - no appointments! It then asked me to call for an appointment!
So I call today and tried to explain the problems I’d been having, only to be subjected to a short tempered young man interrupting saying ‘I get it’ . He couldn’t get it as I hadn’t finished - so after resisting getting angry and not allowing him to hector me, he says the doctors have reviewed my case and don’t think an appointment is required. Bluntly his attitude stank ! The practice can check the recording and will note at no point was I rude or aggressive. He was - so I asked his name - he refused . I wonder why - though no doubt the practice will hide behind some nonsense about protecting staff etc. As I tried to insist on an appointment he cut me off . As it was 1650 my natural cynicism suggests he wanted rid before closing time.
